subject: a cloth draped over a die, polishing one face to a shine, two sparkles above it. Must keep: only one face polished; the polished face keeps the die's own cream colour with white glints, never yellow or gold (gold faces are a separate mechanic); dice pips coloured exactly as in the subject reference (dark pips stay dark, never recoloured red or blue).

extraReferences.role: SUBJECT REFERENCE: the same card drawn in the game's default style. Keep its objects, their arrangement, the idea, and every colour that carries game information: dice pips keep the reference's colours (dark pips stay dark, in the darkest ink of reference image 1; red pips stay red; blue pips stay blue), coloured die faces keep their colour, gold stays gold, and glass or transparent parts stay transparent. Never colour neutral dark pips red or blue. Ignore everything else about its rendering (outlines, shading, halftone, exact shades) and draw it in the style of reference image 1.
